requirements.statement: A user signs in with their own identity so their to-do list is private to them

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor is directed to sign in before reaching the to-do list
After signing in, the user lands on their own to-do list
One user's signed-in session never shows another user's entries

requirements.statement: A signed-in user can add a new to-do entry with a title

criteria.must: Submitting a title creates a new entry visible in the user's list
A newly created entry starts as not-done

requirements.statement: A signed-in user can see the list of all their to-do entries

criteria.must: The list view shows every entry the user has created
The list persists and reappears unchanged after the user signs out and signs back in

requirements.statement: A signed-in user can mark an entry as done or not-done

criteria.must: Marking an entry done updates its displayed state to done
Marking a done entry not-done reverts its displayed state

requirements.statement: A signed-in user can edit the title of an existing entry

criteria.must: Editing an entry's title and saving updates the title shown in the list

requirements.statement: A signed-in user can delete an entry

criteria.must: Deleting an entry removes it from the user's list
A deleted entry does not reappear after signing out and back in
